title: Very nice experience! Ideal with friends or family!
text: The 2h + tapas + open bar formula has largely convinced us! We had a great time at sea with Luigi. Performance at the top! We recommend!
author: D17UGmarions

title: Sailing fun!
text: Marcello was an awesome Captain! The water and weather weren’t ideal, but Marcello did all he could to make it the best trip possible.  We were a group of 8 and had the boat to ourselves.  It was a beautiful boat and beautiful scenery!
author: Maria_D

title: Outstanding and well beyond our expectations!
text: Exceeded every expectation that we could have possibly had.  Marco and crew were absolutely amazing.  The catamaran perfect.  Five star luxury in every step.  We have been in Europe for 3 weeks and this may have the best thing we did.  Don’t even hesitate, and don’t select a different company.  Perfect.
author: 194AdamS

title: Best captain, best trip!
text: We had a lot of fun sailing around Barcelona. Even the weather was not the best, and we could not swim, Sergio made sure that we enjoyed our trip and shared his sailing knowledge with us :)
author: Nilla_M

title: Great boat trip, Perfect for groups.  Good service.  Fantastic value for money.
text: We could not have been better looked after.  We were met on time, taken straight on to the boat, offered food and drinks throughout the trip.  We chose our own music. We were given blankets.  It was too cold to swim but we were taken round the ports and harbours and the coast.   It was perfect for our group of 11.  I would recommend this trip to others.
author: carolcA8825SU

title: Worth every penny
text: Beautiful boat, fantastic captain (Sergio). It was calm going out and Sergio made sure we got to a beautiful place jump in. The swimming was amazing! Crystal clear water.
author: petereC3997TO

title: The only way to see the sea!  Great private experience.
text: There is no better way to explore the Water than your own private experience. Our Captain, Marcelo, was awesome.  He made us feel like family and we were all just out for a family day on the water.  There was plenty of education about the area, great snacks and wonderful drinks.  The water is beautiful.  Thanks Marcelo!
author: Frederick_W

title: Wonderful experience !
text: Wonderful experience, thanks to María, our captain. The boat was perfect for 6 friends and really comfortable. María was so kind with us. She even took some time to take pictures of us. We were able to both enjoy the sailing experience and had some time for swimming with great views of Barcelona. Drinks and some food are provided. Great memories for all of us, we would go back anytime!!
author: Flyer55464632535

title: Great sailing experience
text: We did the 3 hour sail.  It was fantastic.  Our captain Eduardo was knowledgeable about sailing and the region.  He let us choose what we wanted to do.  We did in fact sail not just cruise around under motor power.
author: Robert C

title: Amazing sunset sailing trip with Victoria
text:
The sailing tour is a highly recommended experience to enjoy fantastic views and calm sea for anyone visiting Barcelona or living in the city. 
Thanks to Victoria, our patron, for his naturalness, professionalism and sympathy, which undoubtedly contributed to the Mood being really pleasant and the experience wonderful.
Nice boat, nice weather and great afternoon.
author: Febrer21
